title: Tech Note: Introduction to Object field in v15
author: Vance Villanueva, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: Object field data type (new in v15)
OB SET / JSON PARSE with Object fields

historical_commentary.text: The v15 Object field was a genuinely forward-looking feature, foreshadowing 4D's later embrace of native, indexable JSON-like storage; it remains supported and useful today for schema-less/semi-structured data, though ORDA (introduced ~v16 R5/R6) and the maturing object/entity model have layered richer querying and object-oriented access on top of what QUERY BY ATTRIBUTE offered here. The note's specific syntax and query-string conventions are still functional but somewhat dated compared to ORDA's dot-notation entity selection queries.
related_updates: ORDA (v16 R5/R6, 2017+) added a richer, dot-notation query language over structured/object data
Object fields remain a supported 4D data type for schema-less JSON-like storage
QUERY BY ATTRIBUTE remains available but is used less often now that ORDA entity selections and formulas cover similar ground
